summary: Repaired T101 per review-001.json required_changes. (1) build_panel_provenance now cross-checks every member against the panel-level registry_revision; declared_schema_version and declared_decode_version parameters (optional) tighten the gate further and PanelProvenance carries them forward in the content hash and to_dict() payload. A disagreement raises PanelRegistryRevisionError, with positive (matching) and negative (registry/schema/decode mismatch, invalid value) tests added. (2) FeatureRegistrySnapshot now exposes a get() that resolves a column name against the bound declarations; run_fold_evaluation replaced the synthetic index-rotation placeholder with a real lookup through that snapshot, so both an off-snapshot column and a future-derived decision_time surface FoldVerdictCode.FORWARD_FEATURE_REJECTED through the fold-level path. (3) apply_split_to_panel accepts sample_features: Mapping[str, PanelFeatureRow] and threads the real populated rows into the per-fold (train, eval) tuples; the test pins the populated path and rejects a non-PanelFeatureRow mapping. All existing T101 tests (60) continue to pass; 14 new tests cover the repair. The repository-wide static gates (import-graph, ruff lint, ruff format, mypy) are green on the T101 surface; the two pre-existing base-commit failures (forge oracle + architecture-section22) reproduce on the unchanged base and are not introduced by T101.

residual_risks: Two pre-existing repository-wide failures (test_abi_artifacts forge oracle; test_documentation_citations architecture-section22 T069 finding) reproduce on the unchanged base commit a414ab7 and are not introduced by T101; both still surface in the full pytest output and the reviewer should verify them out-of-band before approving.

The fold-level forward-feature gate now uses the bound registry snapshot to resolve each feature_columns entry by name; a fold whose feature_columns carries a column the snapshot does not declare yields FORWARD_FEATURE_REJECTED. This is the conservative path T102's real feature matrix must populate consistently; absent that, the rejection guard triggers more often than a live consumer would prefer. A future task wiring the panel feature matrix through the fold configuration will keep the gate on while allowing the real names.

The PanelRegistryRevisionError gate fires on every member whose registry_revision differs from the panel-level bound revision. The T100/T069 callers are expected to declare members from a single registry revision; if a future revisioned dataset ever needs to ride alongside an older one, the partition must happen at the dataset layer (separate PanelProvenance per revision) rather than by relaxing this gate.
